title: The Demonic Path Summons
next_chapter_hook: A phantom image of Kunlun's peak appeared within the Summoning Token, where something seemed to await Chen Ji—the gears of fate had begun to turn irreversibly.

text.content:
Midnight, Tianqing Sect Servants' Quarters.

Chen Ji sat cross-legged on a worn-out bed, eyes slightly closed, Spiritual Energy flowing through his body like fine threads. Suddenly, an intense demonic aura tore through the void without warning, like a hungry black giant python, diving directly into this cramped space.

His eyes snapped open, pupils constricted.

A pitch-black token materialized from thin air, inscribed with nine twisted demonic runes, emanating a chilling pressure that struck fear into the heart. The token hovered three feet before Chen Ji, humming and buzzing, as if whispering from the depths of the Nine Abysses.

Summoning Token.

The Summoning Token of the Demonic Path Commander.

dialogue.content:
「What is this!」

Su Qingyao's figure swooped into the room like a startled swan. Her usually ice-cold face was now full of shock. She shielded Chen Ji behind her, sword already drawn, its tip pointing directly at the token radiating overwhelming demonic energy.

text.content:
Chen Ji gently pressed his hand on Su Qingyao's wrist holding the sword, his voice calm to the point of coldness: 「Don't move.」

His gaze locked死死 on the slowly emerging rune at the token's center—a fragmented 「Life」 character, identical to the crack on the Tianji Record Fragment in his embrace.

The Mark of Destiny.

Su Qingyao's willow brows furrowed tightly. She sensed a kind of aura that made her heart tremble. Within that token seemed to lie a power connected to her bloodline yet utterly opposite, frantically tugging at her Heavenly Fate within.

「Chen Ji, this token... something's wrong!」 Her voice trembled slightly, 「There's the aura of destiny within it!」

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji didn't answer, but his pupils constricted sharply.

Twin Souls of Destiny.

A scene from Chapter 777 flashed through his mind—that rainy night when Chen Nian was taken away by the Holy Sect people, the despair and unwillingness in her backward glance, along with that mysterious mark connected to their sibling bloodline.

text.content:
Back then, he had seen a vague prophecy within the Tianji Record: Two souls severed by destiny would reunite at Kunlun's peak. And tonight, the rune on this Summoning Token was identical to the core mark in that prophecy.

This was no coincidence.

dialogue.content:
「What do you actually know?」 Su Qingyao spun around sharply, her gaze like a blade piercing toward Chen Ji, 「Why would the Demonic Path Commander issue you a Summoning Token? What right does a servant disciple have to receive a personal summons from the Demonic Path Commander?」

Her voice carried a hint of unprecedented urgency and... fear.

text.content:
Chen Ji finally raised his head, meeting Su Qingyao's eyes that seemed ready to pierce through him. His lips curved slightly into a meaningful smile: 「Senior Sister Su, what are you afraid of?」

He paused, his voice deep as an abyss: 「Afraid that I'll discover something? Or afraid that I'll walk an irretraceable path?」

dialogue.content:
Su Qingyao's breath hitched.

That was precisely what she feared. This seemingly cowardly废物 disciple always found a way to break deadlocks, always manipulated everyone in the palm of his hand. And now, the Demonic Path's Summoning Token appeared before him—

What did this mean?

text.content:
Just then, the token vibrated violently. A senile yet authoritative voice emerged from within, echoing through the entire Servants' Quarters:

「Chen Ji, this one knows you're calculating. This one also knows what you're holding back.」 That voice carried three parts mockery, seven parts certainty, 「But some fates, are not for you to calculate.」

「Within three days, at Kunlun's peak.」 The voice continued, 「If you don't come, your sister...」

Before the words finished, the token suddenly blazed with blinding black light. A blurry image emerged—a glimpse of Chen Nian imprisoned in an abyss of ten thousand zhang, surrounded by countless chains, her eyes full of despair.

Chen Ji's gaze, in an instant, turned ice-cold to the extreme.

choice.prompt: The Demonic Path Commander's Summoning Token had been issued. The blurry figure of his sister Chen Nian caused Chen Ji's heart to churn. How should he decide?

choices.text: Accept the summons and personally go to Kunlun

choices.visible_cost: Deeply enter the Demonic Path territory, venture alone into danger
choices.visible_reward: May find clues about his sister Chen Nian, unravel the mystery of the Twin Souls of Destiny

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath and reached out to grasp that Summoning Token. The token felt ice-cold in his hand, yet carried a诡异 warmth, as if something alive pulsed within.

「I understand.」 His voice was calm as still water, 「Kunlun's peak, I will go.」

text.content:
The demonic energy on the token seemed to sense his decision, suddenly收敛 and transformed into a beam of black light that entered his Brow Center. A surge of information flooded his mind—the specific location of Kunlun's peak, and a time: the midnight hour three days later.

The countdown of fate, had begun.

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji did not immediately respond to the Summoning Token. Instead, he closed his eyes, his consciousness sinking into the Tianji Record Fragment in his embrace.

The runes on the Fragment glowed faintly, and a profound power surged forth, beginning to deduce the countless possibilities of the Kunlun journey.

text.content:
However, just then, a blurry figure appeared in his foresight vision—it was Chen Nian, but the image was unclear, as if veiled by mist. The runes on the Fragment vibrated intensely, letting out a mournful cry.

「There's interference... cannot see clearly...」

dialogue.content:
「What are you doing?」 Su Qingyao's voice suddenly rose, 「The power on that token is invading your divine sense! Stop immediately!」

She saw诡异的 demonic runes faintly appearing around Chen Ji's body, veins bulging on his forehead, clearly enduring tremendous pain.

text.content:
Chen Ji opened his eyes abruptly, spitting out a mouthful of blood that stained his chest. But the corner of his mouth curved into a cold smile.

「I saw it.」 His voice was hoarse yet carried a hint of excitement, 「Kunlun's peak... the Demonic Path Commander is indeed waiting for me there.」

dialogue.content:
Su Qingyao grabbed the staggering Chen Ji, anxiously saying: 「You madman! That's the Demonic Path Commander's Summoning Token! One misstep and it's utter destruction! Are you really going?」

Her eyes were slightly reddened—this was the first time she lost composure before this废物.

text.content:
Chen Ji gently pushed away her hand, using his sleeve to wipe the blood from the corner of his mouth. His gaze was profound as an abyss, yet his voice was unexpectedly calm:

「Senior Sister Su, you think I have a choice?」

He raised his head, looking at the pitch-black night sky outside the window, his eyes flashing a sharpness never seen before: 「This thing called fate... once it starts, one can only move forward.」

Just then, the Summoning Token vibrated again. A clear image emerged on the token's surface—the phantom of Kunlun's peak.

There, clouds and seas churned, celestial cranes circled, and an ancient altar stood at the highest point. Above the altar, a blurry figure stood with hands clasped behind, overlooking all living beings beneath.

The Demonic Path Commander.

dialogue.content:
「Chen Ji.」 Su Qingyao's voice suddenly became very soft, soft as if afraid to shatter something, 「If you must go... I won't stop you.」

She took a Jade Pendant from her sleeve and pressed it into Chen Ji's hand: 「This is a protective charm left by my mother. Perhaps it can save your life at a critical moment.」

text.content:
Chen Ji lowered his head, looking at the Jade Pendant in his hand. A complex emotion flickered in his eyes. This was the first time Su Qingyao proactively showed him kindness, the first time she放下 that aloof mask.

「Senior Sister Su...」

「Don't say it.」 Su Qingyao interrupted him, turning to walk toward the door, her back view somewhat lonely, 「I just don't want to owe you a favor. The thing in the secret realm last time... I remember it.」

The door closed softly, leaving the room in silence.

Chen Ji sat alone on the bed, pressing that warm Jade Pendant against his heart. The pendant carried Su Qingyao's body temperature, and a faint delicate fragrance.

「Holds grudges but doesn't act rashly...」 he murmured to himself, the corner of his mouth slightly lifting, 「Senior Sister Su, you're becoming more and more interesting.」

Outside the window, the night was deep as ink.

Three days.

He only had three days.

Chen Ji slowly stood up, walked to the window, his gaze fixed on the distant west. That was the direction of Kunlun, the direction fate pointed, and the irretraceable path he must walk.

「Sister...」 he softly murmured, his voice carrying a softness never heard before, 「Wait for me.」

The image on the Summoning Token remained clear, the phantom of Kunlun's peak hazy beneath the moonlight. There, something awaited them—awaited the reunion of the Twin Souls of Destiny.

Only this time, the price of reunion might be everyone's fate.
